summary: Over-capacity routing toggle caused extended queue wait and retries (Hosted us-east)
description:
Issue summary:
Hosted us-east returning 503 "no capacity" with long queue waits for accepted requests. Evidence of retry amplification.

Impact:
Customer-facing degradation on hosted tier; secondary spillover in eu-west.

Environment:
prod us-east; routing policies recently changed for maintenance.

Suspected cause:
Stale routing rule preventing early spillover.
comments: 2025-12-18 18:31 ET (Naomi Feldman): 503s climbing; gpu free slots at 0. Not spilling to us-west.
2025-12-18 18:38 ET (Grace O'Connor): Found maintenance routing toggle still enabled; disabling now.
2025-12-18 18:52 ET (Grace O'Connor): Spillover active; 503 rate dropping.
resolution: Disabled stale maintenance routing rule and increased spillover budget. Added follow-up to auto-expire routing toggles.
